cam_transform: camera-to-world; OpenGL +x right, +y up, forward -z; rendered RGB flipped vertically
ray_channel_order: moment origin cross unit_direction, then unit_direction
source_pixel_offset: source grid adds 0.5 twice; index+1.0; retained unchanged (0.5 pixel relative to usual center convention)
rotation_error: world-frame left multiplication of R only; translation fixed
crop: official RandomCrop crops/resizes stacked RGB+raymap together using the same crop indices
policy_truth_channels: none; evaluator geometry used only for checks
